# idxreplay receipts (W0.4, lane intel, 2026-09-27)

Copies of the small outputs behind `docs/research/fable51_w0_intel_2026-09-27.md`
(originals under `/common/dev/rustred/TMP/w0/intel/`). Binaries: idxreplay-v1 `d39a9183...`,
v3 `c39727e0...`, v4 `46c14a4d...`; trace binary `rustred-trace-edbe2729` `edbe2729...`
(full digests in the note).

| file | content |
|---|---|
| `dynamic-4l.jsonl`, `dynamic-5f.jsonl` (+ `.stderr`) | dynamic replay of the traced four-loop W6/W1 and C-5F W18 runs (v3) |
| `static-g7-1t.jsonl` | static layouts x policies x thinning, one thread, CPUs 10-27 (v1) |
| `static-g7-lane18.jsonl` | 1 vs 18 threads, CPUs 10-27 (v1) |
| `static-g7-threads.jsonl` | 1/48/90 threads on socket 1, CPUs 128-217, interleave 4-7 (v1; foreign load: `socket1-load.txt`) |
| `streams-g7.jsonl`, `streams-g7-v4.jsonl` | real gen-7 streams (v3 run; v4 re-run with native ms per job and stale-lag rows; load `streams-g7-v4.load.txt`) |
| `lag-g7.jsonl` | container age of all 1.19G committed gen-7 edges (v1) |
| `t_*.md` | tables generated by `tools/research/idxreplay/tables.py` |
| `gate04b.txt`, `gate04b.jsonl`, `t_gate04b.md` | gate-0.4(b) projection grid (`project.py`, `scripts/gate04b.sh`) |
| `gate04b-r2.txt`, `gate04b-r2.jsonl` | fix-round cells: SoA-pattern own miss/reverse exponents with bracketed hit exponent (`project.py --class-alpha`), v3 cost-sample noise (`scripts/gate04b_r2.sh`) |
| `socket1-lockstate-2026-09-27T2023Z.txt` | socket1.lock holder/waiters and a 30-s socket-1 load sample at 20:21-20:24Z (`scripts/lockstate.sh`) |
| `socket1-load.txt`, `socket1-session.log` | busy jiffies of CPUs 128-227 and own jiffies, 5-s samples, socket-1 lock session 14:49-15:27Z |
| `g7-trace-resume-run.log`, `trace-5f.metrics.txt` | traced gen-7 resume and C-5F trace receipts |
| `scripts/` | driver scripts as run (absolute paths of the original host layout) |
